meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 菜单栏会出现一个闪电图标:绿点表示 NanoClaw 正在运行,红点表示已停止。点击图标可启动、停止、重启服务,或直接打开日志文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 NanoClaw 添加 macOS 菜单栏状态图标时触发;仅限 macOS,需已安装 Xcode Command Line Tools(swiftc)。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 加到菜单栏
say.note: Claude 会编译并安装状态栏工具

say.text: 安装 NanoClaw 的菜单栏状态指示器
say.note: 执行安装流程并在菜单栏显示图标

say.text: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态
say.note: 需要 macOS 和 Xcode 命令行工具

howto.what_en: A bolt icon appears in the macOS menu bar with a green/red dot showing whether NanoClaw is running. Click it to start, stop, restart the service, or open log files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. macOS only; requires Xcode Command Line Tools (swiftc).

say_en.text: Add NanoClaw to the menu bar for me.
say_en.note: Claude compiles and installs the status bar tool.

say_en.text: Install the NanoClaw menu bar status indicator.
say_en.note: Runs the install flow and shows the icon.

say_en.text: Show NanoClaw's running state in the menu bar.
say_en.note: Requires macOS and Xcode command line tools.
